title: APA remedies: Setting aside, vacatur, and injunctions
shortTitle: APA remedies: Setting aside, vacatur, and injunctions
summary: The assigned final page introduces the disputed relationship between setting aside agency action and enjoining its implementation.
notes:
APA §706 directs reviewing courts to hold unlawful and set aside agency action that violates specified standards. Section 703 identifies available forms of judicial proceeding, including declaratory judgments and prohibitory or mandatory injunctions. The assigned page observes that courts have often described relief using set aside, vacate, and enjoin with little differentiation.

That introduction poses a problem about what a court actually does when it finds agency action unlawful and how far relief extends. It cites CIC Services and begins a National Mining Association example, but the supplied page ends before the latter citation and before the chapter’s analysis of universal relief. Marking the assigned account as incomplete for any resolution of the broader remedial debate.
